First use
Connect the badge with a USB data cable, select it under "Device" and click "Pair". Check the pairing codes on the badge and the Assistant match, then press OK on the badge.

Every day
With the cable in, it uses USB; unplugged, opening Dictation, AI Control or other PC apps switches the Assistant to Bluetooth (click "Connect" when the Mac asks to pair).

Dictation
On the badge's Dictation page press OK to start speaking and OK again to finish; the text is pasted at the Mac's cursor. Needs Accessibility permission, no input method.

Web settings
The seven "Web settings" buttons open pages in the browser: Customize menu, Status Sign, Big Days, QR Code, keywords for opening Mac apps, Remote keys (press the badge's keys from the computer) and Diagnostics (link state to send the developer). Saving writes to the badge.

Other
Install and sign in to Codex and Claude Code yourself. Xiaozhi, weather and radio use the badge's own WiFi; without WiFi it can share the computer's internet over USB.

First use
Connect the badge with a USB data cable, select it under "Device" and click "Pair". Check the pairing codes on the badge and this page match, then press OK on the badge. You can also import the device.json exported after pairing on a Mac.

Every day
The Assistant runs in the tray at the bottom right; click its icon to open this page. With the cable in, it uses USB; unplugged, opening Dictation, AI Control or other PC apps switches it to Bluetooth (click "Allow" when Windows asks to pair).

Dictation
On the badge's Dictation page press OK to start speaking and OK again to finish; the text is pasted at the cursor. No permission or input method needed; windows running as administrator don't receive it.

Away Lock
Windows can't read Bluetooth signal strength, so there is keep-awake and lock-now, but no automatic lock by distance.

Other
Install and sign in to Codex and Claude Code yourself. Xiaozhi, weather and radio use the badge's own WiFi; without WiFi it can share the computer's internet over USB.
